title: Upload
subtitle: Add workouts from files, import your Huawei Health history and manage your watch faces.

workouts.title: Workout files
workouts.intro: Pick .fit, .gpx or .tcx files from a watch, a bike computer or another app. The file is read in your browser; only the resulting workout is uploaded.

drop.hint: FIT, GPX, TCX. Up to {{mb}} MB per file.

watchfaces.title: Watch face library
watchfaces.intro: Upload .hwt watch faces to your account. In JoyoFit on your phone, open Watch faces then From the web, and install to the watch from there.

signing.note: A Huawei watch rejects .hwt files that Huawei has not signed, and JoyoFit cannot sign them: a watch face you made yourself can be removed by the watch after it is installed. A photo face from JoyoFit on your phone works without any .hwt file.

huawei.title: Import from Huawei Health
huawei.intro: Turn your Huawei data export into one import file, right in your browser. Then save the file, or send it to your JoyoFit account so your phone does the importing.
huawei.local: The ZIP and its password never leave this browser, and nothing is read on a server. The only thing that can be sent is the import file it produces, and only when you press Send to phone.

how.title: How to request your data

steps.1: Open privacy.consumer.huawei.com (or in Huawei Health: Me, your account, Privacy Center), choose Request Your Data, and tick Health.
steps.2: Set a ZIP password and keep it somewhere safe. It is the password you type here.
steps.3: Wait for the email from Huawei. It can take up to 7 days, and the link works for 21 days. The file is called HUAWEI_HEALTH_<timestamp>.zip.
steps.4: Before you unbind your watch from Huawei Health, sync it there once more. Data that only lives on the watch is lost when you unbind.

how.disclaimer: JoyoFit is not affiliated with Huawei.

convert.subtitle: Runs in this browser. A large export can take a few minutes.

save.hint: Move the file to your phone, then in JoyoFit open Settings → Import from Huawei Health and choose this file.

send.hint: Needs JoyoRogo Pro. Only the import file is sent, not the ZIP, and it is deleted from the server once your phone has used it.
